# magmacrunch.com

The files served at **[magmacrunch.com](https://magmacrunch.com)**, the website
of magmacrunch media: the music, the archive, the arcade and the ware tools.

## This repository is generated

Every file here is published automatically from the site's source, which is
kept private, and is replaced on the next publish. Edits and pull requests made
here would be overwritten, so issues and pull requests are not taken here.

It holds only what a browser loads to show the site: pages, styles, scripts,
images, audio, and the arcade's games as they run in the browser. Nothing else
from the site's source is published.
